text: {"danger_level":"green","danger_reason":"You are beyond the outdoor evacuation distance of 457 meters for a Car (500 lb) explosion threat.","main_move":"STAY_ALERT","main_move_text":"Stay alert and follow official updates","where_to_go":"Stay where you are and remain inside the building away from line of sight.","do_now":[{"text":"Stay in this preferred area beyond the evacuation line and follow instructions.","advice_ids":["exp.green_area"]},{"text":"Move people out of line of sight of the scene and away from all windows.","advice_ids":["exp.line_of_sight"]},{"text":"Stay cautious because evacuation distances are estimates and nearby areas remain potentially dangerous.","advice_ids":["exp.no_guarantee"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not gather at windows, doorways, or go outside, as secondary attacks may target bystanders.","advice_ids":["exp.secondary"]},{"text":"Do not approach the explosion source or enter the danger zone.","advice_ids":["exp.secondary"]}],"if_you_are":[],"call":["112 - National emergency number","108 - Ambulance","101 - Fire and rescue"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"The evacuation zone is derived from official stand-off distance charts and there is only one data gap.","unknowns":["Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals (emergency tag or large campus); their emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","Bomb stand-off distances are estimates based on test data; the chart states they do not guarantee safety and that the area near the evacuation distances is still potentially dangerous.","Building distances assume typical US commercial construction; Indian buildings may perform differently."],"valid_while":[]}
